topics.title: Number Systems and Complex Numbers
topics.scope: Real numbers and their properties, rational/irrational, complex numbers: algebra, conjugate, modulus, argument, polar form, De Moivre for small powers, square roots of complex numbers, roots of unity (cube roots of unity, ω properties); sets, functions and binary operations, groups (basic).

topics.title: Matrices and Determinants
topics.scope: Types of matrices, addition, multiplication, transpose, symmetric/skew, determinants of 2×2 and 3×3, properties of determinants, cofactors, adjoint, inverse, singular matrices, solving linear systems (Cramer's rule, inverse method), rank basics.

topics.title: Quadratic Equations and Partial Fractions
topics.scope: Solving quadratics, discriminant and nature of roots, sum and product of roots, forming equations from roots, symmetric functions of roots, equations reducible to quadratic, exponential equations, radical equations, remainder and factor theorems, synthetic division; partial fractions (linear, repeated, quadratic factors).

topics.title: Sequences and Series
topics.scope: Arithmetic progression (nth term, sum, arithmetic means), geometric progression (nth term, sum, infinite GP), harmonic progression, relation A ≥ G ≥ H, sums of n, n², n³, word problems on AP/GP.

topics.title: Permutations, Combinations and Probability
topics.scope: Factorial notation, fundamental counting principle, permutations (including repeated and circular), combinations, nCr properties, probability of events, addition and multiplication laws, complementary, independent and mutually exclusive events, simple conditional probability.

topics.title: Mathematical Induction and Binomial Theorem
topics.scope: Principle of mathematical induction (identifying valid statements), binomial theorem for positive integral index, general term, middle term, term independent of x, coefficients and their sums, binomial series for negative/fractional index and approximations.

topics.title: Trigonometry
topics.scope: Radian measure, arc length and sector area, trigonometric ratios of allied angles, identities, sum and difference, double and half angle, sum-to-product, periods and graphs of trigonometric functions, solution of triangles (sine, cosine, tangent rules, area, circum- and in-radius), inverse trigonometric functions, solving trigonometric equations.

topics.title: Functions, Limits and Continuity
topics.scope: Functions: domain, range, composition, inverse, even/odd, graphs and transformations; limits of algebraic, trigonometric and exponential forms (sin x/x, (1 + 1/n)ⁿ, (aˣ − 1)/x), continuity at a point, piecewise functions.

topics.title: Differentiation and its Applications
topics.scope: Derivative from first principles, rules (sum, product, quotient, chain), implicit and parametric differentiation, derivatives of trigonometric, inverse trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions, higher derivatives, tangents and normals, increasing/decreasing, maxima and minima, Maclaurin series basics.

topics.title: Integration
topics.scope: Antiderivatives of standard functions, substitution, integration by parts, partial fractions in integration, definite integrals and their properties, area under a curve and between simple curves, simple differential equations (variables separable).

topics.title: Straight Lines and Linear Inequalities
topics.scope: Distance, section formula, slope, forms of a line, angle between lines, parallel and perpendicular lines, distance from a point to a line, concurrency, area of a triangle by coordinates; linear inequalities in two variables, feasible regions, linear programming (corner points).

topics.title: Circles and Conic Sections
topics.scope: Circle: standard and general equation, centre and radius, tangents and normals, position of a point/line; parabola, ellipse, hyperbola: standard forms, focus, directrix, vertices, eccentricity, latus rectum, axes, asymptotes.

topics.title: Vectors
topics.scope: Vectors in 2-D and 3-D, unit vectors, direction cosines, addition, scalar (dot) product, angle between vectors, projection, vector (cross) product, area of parallelogram and triangle, scalar triple product and volume, work done by a force.

topics.title: Measurements, Vectors and Equilibrium
topics.scope: SI units, prefixes, significant figures, errors and uncertainties, dimensional analysis; vectors: resolution, addition by components, dot and cross products, torque, equilibrium conditions (first and second).

topics.title: Motion and Force
topics.scope: Displacement, velocity, acceleration, equations of motion, velocity-time graphs, Newton's laws, momentum and impulse, conservation of momentum, elastic and inelastic collisions in one dimension, force due to water flow, rocket propulsion, projectile motion (range, height, time of flight).

topics.title: Work, Energy and Power
topics.scope: Work by constant and variable force, power, kinetic and potential energy, work-energy principle, conservation of energy, escape velocity, interconversion of energy, efficiency.

topics.title: Circular Motion, Rotation and Gravitation
topics.scope: Angular displacement, velocity and acceleration, centripetal force, moment of inertia, angular momentum and its conservation, rotational KE, artificial satellites, orbital velocity, real and apparent weight, weightlessness, Newton's law of gravitation, variation of g.

topics.title: Fluid Dynamics
topics.scope: Viscous drag and Stokes' law, terminal velocity, laminar and turbulent flow, equation of continuity, Bernoulli's equation and its applications (Venturi, Torricelli).

topics.title: Oscillations
topics.scope: Simple harmonic motion, its equations, mass-spring system, simple pendulum, energy in SHM, phase, free and forced oscillations, resonance, damping.

topics.title: Waves and Sound
topics.scope: Progressive waves, wave speed v = fλ, speed of sound (Newton and Laplace correction, temperature effect), principle of superposition, interference, beats, stationary waves on strings and in pipes (harmonics), Doppler effect.

topics.title: Physical Optics and Optical Instruments
topics.scope: Wavefronts, Huygens' principle, Young's double slit, thin films, Newton's rings, Michelson interferometer, diffraction (single slit, grating), polarisation; magnification, simple and compound microscope, telescope, resolving power, optical fibres.

topics.title: Heat and Thermodynamics
topics.scope: Kinetic theory of gases, pressure and temperature, ideal gas law, internal energy, first law of thermodynamics, isothermal and adiabatic processes, molar specific heats, heat engines, Carnot cycle and efficiency, second law, entropy (basic).

topics.title: Electrostatics and Capacitors
topics.scope: Coulomb's law, electric field and field lines, electric flux and Gauss's law, electric potential and potential difference, electron volt, field and potential of point charges, capacitors (parallel plate, dielectrics, series and parallel, energy stored), charging and discharging (time constant).

topics.title: Current Electricity
topics.scope: Current, drift, Ohm's law, resistivity and its temperature dependence, colour code, series and parallel, electrical power, EMF and internal resistance, maximum power transfer, Kirchhoff's rules, Wheatstone bridge, potentiometer, thermistors.

topics.title: Electromagnetism, Induction and AC
topics.scope: Magnetic field of currents, force on a current-carrying conductor and on moving charges, e/m, galvanometer, ammeter and voltmeter conversion; Faraday's and Lenz's laws, motional EMF, self and mutual induction, energy in an inductor, generators, motors, back EMF, transformers; AC: rms values, phase, reactance, impedance in RC/RL/RLC, resonance, power in AC circuits.

topics.title: Physics of Solids and Electronics
topics.scope: Stress, strain, Young's modulus, elastic limit, energy bands, conductors, semiconductors and insulators, p- and n-type, p-n junction, rectification, transistor basics, logic gates (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR truth tables).

topics.title: Modern, Atomic and Nuclear Physics
topics.scope: Special relativity basics (time dilation, length contraction, mass-energy), photoelectric effect, Compton effect, pair production, de Broglie waves, uncertainty principle; Bohr model, hydrogen spectrum, X-rays, lasers; nucleus, mass defect, binding energy, radioactivity, half-life, nuclear reactions, fission, fusion, radiation detectors and safety.

topics.title: Synonyms and Word Meaning
topics.scope: Vocabulary at SAT/HSSC level: choose the word closest in meaning to a given word (stem names the word in capitals), or the meaning of a word in a short sentence context.

topics.title: Antonyms
topics.scope: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to a given word in capitals; distractors include synonyms and look-alike words.

topics.title: Analogies
topics.scope: Word-pair relationships (part-whole, cause-effect, tool-user, degree, type-of, antonym pairs): stem 'A : B as' with four pair options written 'x : y'.

topics.title: Sentence Completion
topics.scope: One- or two-blank sentence completion testing vocabulary, logic and connectors (although, therefore, despite); blanks written as ______; two-blank options written 'word ... word'.

topics.title: Grammar and Error Identification
topics.scope: Subject-verb agreement, tenses, pronouns, prepositions, articles, modifiers, parallelism, comparison, conditionals, active/passive and direct/indirect speech; identify the error (underlined parts given as (A) … (D) in the stem), choose the correct sentence, or improve the sentence.

topics.title: Reading Comprehension
topics.scope: Original passages of 180-260 words (science, history, society, technology) with 3 questions each: main idea, detail, inference, vocabulary in context, author's tone or purpose.

topics.title: Mole Concept and Stoichiometry
topics.scope: Atoms, molecules, ions, relative masses, mole and Avogadro's number, molar volume, empirical and molecular formulae, stoichiometric calculations, limiting reactant, yield; experimental techniques (filtration, crystallisation, sublimation, solvent extraction, chromatography).

topics.title: Gases, Liquids and Solids
topics.scope: Gas laws, ideal gas equation, Dalton's and Graham's laws, kinetic theory, real gases; intermolecular forces, hydrogen bonding, vapour pressure, boiling point; crystalline solids, lattice types, unit cell basics.

topics.title: Atomic Structure
topics.scope: Discovery of particles, Rutherford and Bohr models, hydrogen spectrum, quantum numbers, orbitals, Aufbau, Pauli, Hund's rule, electronic configurations.

topics.title: Chemical Bonding
topics.scope: Ionic, covalent, coordinate and metallic bonds, electronegativity, polarity, VSEPR shapes, hybridisation (sp, sp², sp³), sigma and pi bonds, bond energy, dipole moment.

topics.title: Thermochemistry
topics.scope: Exothermic and endothermic reactions, enthalpy changes (formation, combustion, neutralisation, atomisation), Hess's law, Born-Haber cycle (basic), calorimetry.

topics.title: Chemical Equilibrium and Kinetics
topics.scope: Reversible reactions, law of mass action, Kc and Kp, Le Chatelier's principle, ionic product of water, pH, buffers, solubility product, common ion effect; reaction rate, order, half-life, activation energy, catalysis.

topics.title: Solutions and Electrochemistry
topics.scope: Concentration units, Raoult's law, colligative properties; oxidation numbers, balancing redox, electrolysis, electrochemical cells, electrode potentials, batteries and corrosion.

topics.title: Periodic Table, s- and p-Block Elements
topics.scope: Periodic trends (atomic radius, ionisation energy, electron affinity, electronegativity), alkali and alkaline earth metals and compounds, groups III-VII elements and their compounds, halogens, noble gases.

topics.title: Transition Elements
topics.scope: Electronic configuration, variable oxidation states, colour, magnetism, complexes and ligands, coordination number, chromate/dichromate and permanganate chemistry, iron and steel.

topics.title: Organic Basics and Hydrocarbons
topics.scope: Organic compounds, functional groups, isomerism, IUPAC naming, alkanes, alkenes, alkynes (preparation and reactions), benzene and its electrophilic substitution, reaction mechanisms basics.

topics.title: Alkyl Halides, Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers
topics.scope: Alkyl halides: SN1, SN2, E1, E2, Grignard reagents; alcohols: classification, preparation, reactions, Lucas test; phenol acidity and reactions; ethers.

topics.title: Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids
topics.scope: Preparation and reactions of aldehydes and ketones (nucleophilic addition, Tollens' and Fehling's tests, iodoform), carboxylic acids and derivatives, esters, amides, amino acids.

topics.title: Macromolecules, Industrial and Environmental Chemistry
topics.scope: Polymers (addition and condensation), carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, fertilisers, cement, paper, petrochemicals, air and water pollution, ozone depletion, green chemistry.

topics.title: Biological Molecules and Enzymes
topics.scope: Water, carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, conjugated molecules; enzyme structure, mechanism (lock-and-key, induced fit), factors affecting enzyme activity, inhibitors, cofactors.

topics.title: Cell Structure and Function
topics.scope: Microscopy, cell theory, plasma membrane models, cell wall, organelles (nucleus, mitochondria, plastids, ER, Golgi, lysosomes, ribosomes), prokaryotic vs eukaryotic cells.

topics.title: Variety of Life: Viruses, Bacteria, Protists, Fungi
topics.scope: Classification and five-kingdom system, binomial nomenclature, viruses (structure, lytic and lysogenic cycles, HIV, hepatitis), bacteria, cyanobacteria, protists, fungi and their importance.

topics.title: Kingdom Plantae
topics.scope: Bryophytes, tracheophytes, alternation of generations, evolution of seed habit, gymnosperms and angiosperms, families of flowering plants.

topics.title: Kingdom Animalia
topics.scope: Characteristics and classification of animal phyla (Porifera to Chordata), body symmetry, coelom, diploblastic and triploblastic organisation.

topics.title: Bioenergetics
topics.scope: Photosynthesis (light and dark reactions, photosystems, factors), cellular respiration (glycolysis, Krebs cycle, electron transport chain, ATP yield), anaerobic respiration, photorespiration.

topics.title: Nutrition, Gaseous Exchange and Transport
topics.scope: Autotrophic and heterotrophic nutrition, human digestive system, disorders; gaseous exchange in plants and humans, respiratory disorders; transport in plants (xylem, phloem, transpiration), human heart, blood, blood vessels, lymphatic system, immunity.

topics.title: Homeostasis, Support and Movement
topics.scope: Osmoregulation, excretion, nephron structure and urine formation, thermoregulation; skeleton, joints, muscle structure and sliding filament theory, plant support and movements.

topics.title: Coordination and Control
topics.scope: Plant hormones, nervous system, neuron, nerve impulse, synapse, reflex arc, brain parts, endocrine glands and hormones, feedback mechanisms, behaviour.

topics.title: Reproduction, Growth and Development
topics.scope: Asexual and sexual reproduction in plants and animals, human reproductive systems, menstrual cycle, sexually transmitted diseases, embryonic development, ageing, regeneration.

topics.title: Chromosomes, DNA, Cell Cycle and Genetics
topics.scope: Chromosome structure, DNA replication, transcription, translation, genetic code, mutations; mitosis, meiosis, cell cycle control; Mendel's laws, dominance types, multiple alleles, blood groups, sex linkage, linkage and crossing over.

topics.title: Biotechnology and Evolution
topics.scope: Recombinant DNA, restriction enzymes, vectors, PCR, gene therapy, cloning, GM organisms; theories of evolution, Darwinism, Hardy-Weinberg (basic), evidence of evolution.

topics.title: Ecosystem and Environment
topics.scope: Ecosystem components, food chains and webs, energy flow, biogeochemical cycles, succession, biomes, population dynamics, pollution, conservation, deforestation, climate change.

topics.title: Arithmetic and Word Problems
topics.scope: Percentages, ratio and proportion, averages, profit and loss, simple and compound interest, speed-distance-time, work and time, mixtures, number properties (divisibility, primes, LCM, HCF), fractions and decimals.

topics.title: Algebra and Functions
topics.scope: Linear and quadratic equations, simultaneous equations, inequalities, exponents and logarithms, sequences, functions and graphs, word problems leading to equations.

topics.title: Geometry and Trigonometry
topics.scope: Angles, triangles, Pythagoras, similar triangles, circles, polygons, perimeter, area and volume, coordinate geometry basics, basic trigonometric ratios and heights and distances.

topics.title: Matrices
topics.scope: Matrix operations, determinants of 2×2 and 3×3, inverse of 2×2, solving two simultaneous equations by matrices.

topics.title: Probability and Statistics
topics.scope: Mean, median, mode, range, standard deviation (simple), reading tables and charts, counting, permutations and combinations, basic probability.

topics.title: Limits and Basic Calculus
topics.scope: Limits of simple functions, derivatives of polynomials, rates of change, maxima and minima in simple business contexts (profit, cost), basic integration of polynomials.
